$comment: D4.45 — the LegalAId 100-level Document Generation & Quality Standard: 60 generation levels and 40 quality levels, mapped against the code as it stands on 16 October 2026.

This is the TARGET standard and an honest first map of where the engine stands against it. It is not a claim that any level is complete, and 100 levels do not make a document 100% legally correct: they say what has been checked, what is uncertain, and what an advocate has actually approved.

The map was produced by reading the code (two read-only reviews of backend/, IRE/, knowledge-base/, tests/), and the most serious findings were re-checked by hand. Each status is a first assessment; a level is EXISTS only when it is enforced for every family it applies to AND has a test that fails when it breaks.
review_status: PROPOSED STANDARD — adopted as the target by the owner (D4.45). Statuses are engineering assessments. Nothing here is legal advice.

three_requirements.engineering_correctness: The system produces exactly what its knowledge and inputs specify.
three_requirements.legal_correctness: An advocate has verified that the authored legal positions are sound and scoped.
three_requirements.document_correctness: The rendered instrument is internally coherent, complete and faithful to the user's transaction.

statuses.EXISTS: enforced for every family it applies to, with a failing-capable test
statuses.PARTIAL: some families or aspects, or computed but not acted on, or test-only
statuses.NEEDS_LEGAL_JUDGMENT: can only be completed by an advocate's recorded decision

per_level_record.state: Not yet written for any level. Each level carries the empty record; filling it is part of building the level.
evidence_for_every_finding: the test proving the check can fail

target.meaning: A critical error, contradiction or invalid requirement prevents release.
target.today: EXISTS — any CRITICAL or blocks_generation finding; generation and export refuse.

target.meaning: Material facts or choices are missing.
target.today: EXISTS since D4.46 — APPLICABILITY_UNKNOWN and unverifiable or stale evidence give 'Requires information' (release_outcome REQUIRES_INFORMATION); it outranks legal review, and a blocking finding outranks both.

target.meaning: A substantive legal question remains unresolved.
target.today: EXISTS since D4.46 — unmet held or ESCALATE/DISCLOSE requirements, contradicted character, unreadable relationships, and withdrawn or superseded outputs give 'Requires legal review'. LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED findings outside the requirement model still ship as 'Review Required'. D4.47: also a model's verdict (AI review), a usury concern, and a survival list that does not match the document.

target.meaning: Implemented automated checks passed; not a legal approval.
A defined family and variant reviewed and approved within its recorded scope.
target.today: MISSING — 0 families approved; familyCertification is not attached to outputs.

release_outcomes.rule: A critical failure at any level blocks, whatever the other levels show. A score may be shown only as an automated-check score and may never override a blocking or legal-review outcome.
release_outcomes.today_the_score: Itemised deductions (CRITICAL 40, HIGH 20, MEDIUM 10, LOW 2). A blocked document still shows a number (e.g. 60). Deduplication keys on rule_id+clause+message, so one defect found by several evaluators is charged several times.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: backend/services/deterministicFixer.js rewrites any interest rate of 40% or more to '24%' (USURIOUS_INTEREST_RATE) and any MSME payment period of 60 days or more to '45 days', in the clause text, without asking. Because economic input mismatches are advisory, the draft ships with a figure the user did not enter.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: The fixer no longer rewrites any clause text (backend/services/deterministicFixer.js); every machine mutation passes backend/services/mutationGuard.js. A 48% loan ships at 48% and is flagged USURIOUS_INTEREST_RATE.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: After the AI merge, attachDraftContext(..., { resetBaseline: true }) rebuilds baseline_clause_map from the AI text (documentService.js), so CLAUSE_TAMPER_DETECTED compares the AI's text with itself.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: AI output is checked against metadata.pre_ai_baseline, written once before any AI change and never reset (validateAIIntegrity, layer ai_integrity, AI_CHANGED_AGREED_TERMS CRITICAL). The merge also refuses AI clauses that change figures.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: POST /fix-issue (issueRepairService) applies AI edits to any clause id with no check of locked or protected clauses.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: repairDocumentIssue passes every AI edit through guardDraftMutation: locked or protected clauses, removed user figures and introduced figures are refused, and the user is told why.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: 34 requirements are authored when_unsatisfied: BLOCK; assessRequirements reports blocking:true, but assessment runs in buildSuccess after the release decision, so none blocks.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: The requirement model runs as a validation layer (backend/services/requirementRelease.js) and decides release in five states. Each of the 34 BLOCK requirements was audited individually (governance/block-requirements-audit.json): 23 ACTIVE_BLOCK, 11 held (Requires legal review when unmet).

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: docs/audit/FAMILY_CERTIFICATION.txt: the NDA ships CONFIDENTIALITY_PERIOD_COHERENT: CONTRADICTED (5 years vs 3 years) and is labelled 'Automated checks passed'.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: Frozen as tests/fixtures/ndaContradiction.D4_46.json (24 months vs a two-year term and three further years, certified 'Automated checks passed' at 100); now Blocked with MATERIAL_CONTRADICTION. The relationship compares periods (answer_kind DURATION), and NDA_TERM_SURVIVAL_001 has a renderer that uses agreement_term and defers to Duration of Confidentiality.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: familyCertification.certify runs only in scripts and tests; nothing withholds a NOT_ASSESSED family. LEGALAID_REQUIRE_REVIEWED_CLAUSES is off and does not filter generation.
runStatutoryValidation swallows errors and returns no issues, and coverage does not record the layer as skipped.
The semantic seed is not variable-injected, so on the AI path the model fills values in clauses that have no renderer, outside provenance.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: The semantic seed is createDeterministicBaseDraft(generationInput), variable-injected, so the AI starts from and is judged against the user's values.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: The NDA asked for an Agreement Term (required) and NDA_TERM_SURVIVAL_001 was static library text stating 'two (2) years' whatever was entered.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: The renderer takes the term from agreement_term.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: enhanceCommercially injects CORE_INDEMNITY_FULL_001 and CORE_LIABILITY_LIMIT_FALLBACK_001 after documentHardening renders CORE_SURVIVAL_001, so a document that passes clean names fewer surviving provisions than it contains; one that enters the repair round is re-rendered correctly. Measured on the D4.46 conservation capture: 8 of 113 shipped documents with a survival clause (NDA 5, LEAVE_AND_LICENSE 3); 16 before D4.46.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.next: Belongs with the injected-protections workstream: render enumerating clauses after injection, so the text never depends on whether validation found anything.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: The survival list is drawn by clause id against knowledge-base/metadata/survival_semantics.json (not titles), rendered again as the last stage once the clause set is final, and checked against the document on every validation (SURVIVAL_REFERENCES_MISMATCH, Requires legal review). The 8 documents are frozen as tests/fixtures/survivalStale.D4_47.json.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: MOU NON_BINDING_CHARACTER applies 'always'. For an MOU the user declares Binding or Partly binding it reports unmet; held, so the outcome is 'Requires legal review', never a block. Its applicability should rest on binding_nature, which is a legal decision for the advocate.

Now that requirements decide release, three families no longer pass clean on the fixture corpus: EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT lacks a POSH provision (POSH_AWARENESS_REFLECTED) although the form asks for the Internal Committee's details; RENTAL_AGREEMENT does not deal with delivery of possession (POSSESSION_DELT_WITH; RENT_POSSESSION_001 is in the library, not the blueprint); SHAREHOLDERS_AGREEMENT cannot check transfer restrictions against Articles nobody supplied. Each is 'Requires legal review' or 'Requires information', as the requirement says; none is hidden.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.next: Per family: decide whether the blueprint should carry the provision (advocate), or ask for the evidence.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: No fixture world of CHEQUE_BOUNCE_NOTICE or POWER_OF_ATTORNEY generates (constraint refusals, tracked in governance/block-decomposition.json), so their 7 BLOCK requirements have no corpus evidence and are held rather than activated.

Reported by the user: documents shown green could not be downloaded. Export re-validates in 'final' mode, where the AI safety layer runs for any AI-touched or edited draft and never ran in what the user was shown. Its tamper heuristics read the engine's own '(iii)', 'Schedule III' and clauses opening '(a)' as malformed text; with nothing changed it judged every clause as an edit; and a model's unverified verdict blocked. Measured: 18 of 58 corpus documents refused once AI-touched, including MASTER_SERVICE_AGREEMENT and SETTLEMENT_AGREEMENT shown 'Automated checks passed' at 100.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: Roman numerals and leading enumerators are legal drafting; only text an edit introduced is judged; an unchanged draft has nothing judged; a model's verdict is 'Requires legal review', never a block. Deterministic tampering still blocks. Frozen as tests/fixtures/exportRefusal.D4_47.json.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: AI edits from the chat panel were applied in the browser with no check: locked clauses, figures and meaning could all change.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: POST /chat passes every edit through the mutation guard; figures the user typed are authorised.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: Export-time quality controls ran on the user's draft with no guard. Measured a fixed point on all 58 engine drafts; on edited text they normalise.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: Guarded (figures, locks); the export carries what the user saw if a change is refused.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: The D4.46 guard compared figures and locks only. A rewrite keeping every number could drop 'not', turn 'shall' into 'may', remove an 'unless', exchange the parties or remove a remedy; numbers in words were invisible.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: For AI changes the guard reads negation, obligation words, conditions and exceptions, remedies, parties and numbers in words. Still not caught, and asserted as such: scope quantifiers, temporal order, standards of conduct, subject matter (governance/mutation-paths.json).

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: A model's reading (AI_SEMANTIC_*) blocked with CRITICAL severity; USURIOUS_INTEREST_RATE said a rate 'appears usurious' and suggested 'typically below 24%', which reads as a legal limit section 3 does not have.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.resolution: Both are now 'Requires legal review', marked verified_authority false, and say they are not a legal conclusion.

defects_found_by_the_mapping.what: Text inserted by quality controls after normalizeClauseText is never role-normalised, so NDA_DISCLOSURE_PERMITTED_001 ships 'the Recipient', and the Software Development Agreement's IP_LICENSE_001 and IP_LICENSE_RESTRICTIONS_001 ship 'the Licensor'/'the Licensee', none of which the documents define. A second normalisation would fix those and break LOAN_AMOUNT_001 ('Principal sum' to 'Borrower sum'). Measured: 6 of 58 drafts not a fixed point.
defects_found_by_the_mapping.next: One normalisation stage after the last insertion, with defined terms ('Principal' in a loan) masked, and an idempotence test on the corpus.

duplicate_evaluators.rule: Before building a missing level, choose the one owner of its topic; do not add a fourth predicate grammar or a seventh placeholder rule.

topics.governing law, forum, restraint, ouster,: two or three rules each (see the quality map)
